caption: The drawing features three black line sketches of a spoon on a yellowed, off-white background. The first spoon, positioned at the top, is shown from an overhead view with a distinctive pattern on the bowl and the letters "P D E" inscribed on the handle, along with a small section of textured lines near the junction between the handle and bowl. The second spoon, located in the middle, is also depicted from an overhead view and appears simpler in design, with a rounded bowl and a slightly tapered handle ending in a small oval outline near the tip. The third spoon, at the bottom, is rendered in profile, displaying the side view of the bowl, which has a concave curve and short, diagonal lines indicating texture or shadow. The composition is minimal, with each spoon centered and spaced separately in a vertical column. In the lower left corner of the page, the name "WALT O N K" is written in black. The edges of the paper are marked by faint rectangular outlines and subtle discoloration.
title: Silver Teaspoon
